    Questions

    Is Tobee really free?

    Yes. No ads, no account and no hidden payments.

    Why isn’t it on the Play Store?

    Not yet. For now you download it straight from this page, and it installs like any other app.

    Is it safe to install from here?

    Android shows a warning for any app from outside the Play Store. That is normal. Tobee doesn’t need the internet, and nothing on your phone is ever sent anywhere.

    Does Tobee read my messages?

    Only the notifications your phone already shows, so it can keep them for you. Everything stays on your phone.

    Does it work without internet?

    Yes. Tobee works offline, including your saved QR codes and IDs. It only goes online when you tap Check for updates in Settings.
